dataset: Hillenbrand et al. (1995) American English vowels
observation_unit: one /hVd/ vowel token nested within one of 139 speakers
annotation_process: acoustic measurements released from Hillenbrand et al. (1995); phonTools::h95 supplies imputed values for 10 originally missing F2 and 41 originally missing F3 measurements
sampling_and_dependence: each speaker contributes one token for each of 12 vowels, so vowel rows repeat speakers
original_use: acoustic description and identification of 12 American English vowels across men, women, and children
teaching_simplification: retains source identifiers and acoustic variables from the complete phonTools table; natural missingness is reserved for data/hillenbrand-raw
